entities.name: Minsc
entities.description: A large, bald human ranger, kind-hearted but addled, who talks to his hamster Boo; not a planeswalker in lore.

entities.name: Boo
entities.description: Minsc's hamster, believed by him to be a miniature giant space hamster.
